019package org.apache.wiki.api.events;
020
021import org.apache.wiki.api.core.Engine;
022import org.apache.wiki.api.engine.Initializable;
023import org.apache.wiki.event.WikiEventListener;
024
025import java.util.ArrayList;
026import java.util.List;
027import java.util.Properties;
028
029/**
030 *
031 * @param  <T> the type of the events' source.
032 */
033public interface CustomWikiEventListener< T > extends WikiEventListener, Initializable {
034
035    /** {@link WikiEventListener}s are stored on a {@code List< WeaKReference >} so we use this List to strong reference custom event listeners. */
036    List< CustomWikiEventListener< ? > > LISTENERS = new ArrayList<>();
037
038    /**
039     * Returns the object of the events' source. Typically, it will be obtained on the
040     * {@link Initializable#initialize(Engine, Properties)} method, and returned here.
041     *
042     * @return the object of the events' source.
043     */
044    T client();
045
046}
